notes.text:
This update for poppler fixes the following issues:

- CVE-2025-32364: integer overflow due to INT_MIN negation in the PSStack::roll function of Function.cc leads to
  floating point exception crash in pdftotext (bsc#1240880).
- CVE-2025-32365: misplaced isOk check in the JBIG2Bitmap::combine function of JBIG2Stream.cc leads to out-of-bounds
  read (bsc#1240881).
